Repositories.SizeHint: Best-effort size includes Git data and may retain a prior value during an operation.

Confirm.AllTargets: All {0} configured repositories, independent of inventory filters.
Confirm.SyncEffect: Synchronization fetches or clones the remote, forcibly checks out and hard-resets to the target branch, and removes untracked files. Tracked changes and divergent local state can be discarded.
Confirm.DeleteEffect: The complete local directory, including Git data and local-only files, will be removed. Registration and remote remain configured. Synchronizing can clone the remote again, but cannot restore discarded local-only content.
Confirm.EvidenceHint: These are frozen confirmation targets; local disk contents can change before execution.
